recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce or edit a core ShareableValueSet profile for FHIR-14069; handle any future profile-specific corrections in CRMI, and treat any concern about the frozen STU3 publication as a separate historical-publication process.
issue_request: FHIR-14069 is a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for STU3 asking to remove ValueSet.immutable from the ShareableValueSet profile because it did not change anything relative to base ValueSet and made the differential table confusing.
initial_application: Git commit d661e10df91629292e27e58e9b4d039facfbab90, imported from svn revision 13447 as "GF#14069 - fix value set profile", removed the ValueSet.immutable row from source/valueset/valueset-shareable-spreadsheet.xml. The later XML StructureDefinition form of the core ShareableValueSet profile, just before it was deleted by FHIR-37959, also had no ValueSet.immutable differential element.
additional_context: FHIR-37959 later migrated the Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable terminology-resource profiles out of core and into CRMI while preserving their canonical URLs; its audit commit is already on the combined branch. Current core source has no active shareablevalueset profile entry, source/valueset/implementationguide-ValueSet-core.xml contains no profile resources, and current source search finds only incidental comments and OID metadata. build.fhir.org/shareablevalueset.html returns 404, and the CRMI continuous-build package contains ShareableValueSet profile definitions with no immutable differential paths. The frozen STU3 publication still contains generated immutable entries, but that historical publication surface is outside this current-source reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core source is already correct for this issue because the old differential cleanup was applied and the profile is no longer built from core; the external CRMI profile surface checked during reconciliation also omits ValueSet.immutable.

related_jiras.note: Migrated the Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable terminology-resource profiles out of core and into CRMI; already represented on the combined branch.
